notes.title: Debut Festival 2025
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We're excited to be part of the [b]Debut Festival 2025[/b], alongside many other promising indie games![/p][p][/p][p]Our stores are starting to get seriously out of control... They could really use a helping hand.[/p][p]Think you've got what it takes to bring some order? [b]Come try out the demo![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550120/7acf0573329e350babb76d665f5c8160ee568805.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Roadmap
notes.notes: [p][b]Hey all![/b][/p][p][/p][p]This week, we’ve reached [b]2,000 levels played![/b] That’s a huge milestone, and we want to [b]thank all of you[/b] for giving the demo a try. It motivates us to keep working hard to deliver the best possible experience while preserving the features you loved in the demo. Let’s dive into what’s coming with the [b]full release in September![/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Online & Solo Modes[/b][/h2][p]Our first mission is to introduce [b]online multiplayer[/b], while still keeping [b]local play[/b]. This means you’ll be able to connect with up to three [b]friends around the world[/b], or play locally by connecting four controllers or keyboards to the same computer. We do want to point out that local and online modes can [b]not[/b] be combined simultaneously.[/p][p]We are also adding a brand-new [b]solo mode[/b], allowing you to complete every level on your own.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550120/b42d66cfdf33f856aa48aff2f4da725017669a3d.png"][/img][i]Get ready to dance with your friends[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Customer Redesign[/b][/h2][p]Customers are at the heart of our gameplay and they deserve special attention. We’re giving them a [b]complete overhaul[/b], both in mechanics and visuals. Each new customer will now introduce fresh challenges. Get ready to deal with the ever-angry fashionista screaming through your store, or prevent wild kids from throwing your items everywhere.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550120/aab64c0c8a40d8e51bb6bc4e617cfbab6e2e9d51.png"][/img][i]Work in progress - New customers' 3D models[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Environments and Unique Events[/b][/h2][p]With new levels making their way through the release, we’re dividing the progression through [b]four worlds[/b]: the Mall, the Farm, the City and the Beach.[/p][p]Each world features [b]unique visuals, food types and unlockable cosmetics[/b]. But that’s not all! Each one also includes a [b]world-specific event[/b] that will shake up the gameplay! Fend off a horde of seagulls, or dodge a Martian’s tractor beam… all while keeping your store clean and welcoming.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550120/d97742910c726e0ef31bc2e1c7fca3c4f8d61ba2.gif"][/img][i]New environments' concept art[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Customization and progression[/b][/h2][p]New worlds mean new customization options! We’re adding around [b]80 cosmetic items[/b] to the game, including hairstyles, hats, body accessories and delightfully weird heads.[/p][p]All those skins come with a [b]brand-new way of unlocking them[/b], divided in two parts : [/p][olist][*][p]Earn stars by completing levels: every 3 stars unlocks a cosmetic.[/p][/*][*][p]Beat a level with the highest score to unlock an additional cosmetic.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Whether you prefer a chill pace or a big challenge, [b]you’ll always earn something for your dedication![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550120/f104de2b7174136548c8c789a602d3c460242983.png"][/img][i]Progression menu concept[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Store Mechanics[/b][/h2][p]We’re introducing two new mechanics to bring even more variety… [b]and chaos[/b]: the self-checkout machine and the movable aisles.[/p][p]Self-checkouts let [b]customers pay on their own[/b]. But keep an eye on them: they might break down and need a quick intervention before the customer loses patience.[/p][p]Movable aisles periodically shift around the store, forcing you to [b]adapt your strategy in real time[/b]. They can create new pathways or block existing ones, [b]dynamically changing the layout[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550120/8c8b5999f106beb20353fbb72ee94227e43cfaa6.gif"][/img][i]Moving aisles prototype[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Accessibility[/b][/h2][p]Finally, we’re dedicating time and care to the [b]accessibility features[/b], so as many people as possible can enjoy Out of Stock! [b]in the best conditions[/b].[/p][p]A detailed devlog will come later, but here’s a quick preview of what we’re planning: Colorblind-friendly palettes, high-contrast mode, input remapping, font and language customization, UI noise reduction, [b]and more.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550120/e236717e62a4da1a446f79763e8b162b21a842cd.png"][/img][i]Accessibility menu concept[/i][/p][p][/p][p]That’s it for this roadmap! We hope you’re as excited as we are for what’s coming next. We can't wait to hear what you think of these new features, so don't hesitate to leave a comment![/p][p]Thanks for reading, and [b]keep an eye on our social media[/b] for more updates on Out of Stock! [/p][p][b]‘Till next time ![/b][/p]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest
notes.notes: [p]Wow ! Last week was the Steam Next Fest, and with nearly 20k satisfied customers served with passion (and a little mess...), we can say you nailed this ![/p][p][/p][p]We'd like to thank all of you for playing the demo. This was a huge milestone for us, and we can't wait to release the full game later this year. Stay tuned for more informations about what's coming next ![/p][p][/p][p]Maxi Mini Studio[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550120/38033fb4b3d2f7a3aa741a08d0b58e91231d443d.png"][/img][/p]
